A '''particle detector''' detects [[quantum particle]]s travelling through it.

== Mechanism ==

[[File:Compact Muon Solenoid detector.jpg|thumbnail|Cross-section of a compact muon solenoid detector]]

Modern particle detectors are split into '''subdectors''', each designed to measure specific properties of certain types of particles.

* '''Tracking devices''' determine the path of particles and thereby their momentum (e.g., a [[silicon tracking system]]);
* '''Calorimeters''' measure the particles' energy (e.g., an [[electromagnetic calorimeter]]);
* '''Particle identification detectors''' measure usually the particles' mass
